`DxilHash.cpp` is the unchanged Microsoft DirectXShaderCompiler
container hash implementation from `lib/DxilHash/DxilHash.cpp`,
retrieved on 2026-09-14. EDVR uses `ComputeHashRetail` to validate and
rebuild SM5 DXBC containers. The upstream license is retained in
`LICENSE.TXT`.

Source:
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/blob/main/lib/DxilHash/DxilHash.cpp

The graphics DLL embeds the Microsoft copyright notice and license as
RCDATA resources 40065 and 40066. Release archives also carry the
license as `DXBC-HASH-LICENSE.txt`.
